blocks.title: The Bulletin
blocks.meta: Monthly scratch night — The Old Red Lion, Islington

blocks.heading: What it is
blocks.body:
The Bulletin is a monthly work-in-progress night from the Here & Now ensemble — a scratch night built fresh for the room every time: music, cabaret, sketches and short plays, with a house band keeping the whole thing moving.

Every month brings a different guest host, in the Saturday Night Live tradition, steering the night alongside the company. The first hour is fast, satirical and topical — whatever's actually happened that week, turned into material within days. The second half hands the stage to one member of the ensemble, sharing a work in progress of their own.

blocks.heading: From the company
blocks.quote: We started The Bulletin because the news moves faster than theatre usually does, and we wanted a room where that speed was the point — somewhere an idea from Monday could be a song by Friday.

blocks.heading: Venue & tickets
blocks.body:
The Bulletin runs monthly at The Old Red Lion, Islington — a pub theatre with exactly the kind of room this needs: small enough that the crowd and the stage feel like the same thing.

Tickets are through TicketTailor. Booking embed / link TBC — a fuller box office on its own subdomain may follow.

items.question: How often does it run?
items.answer: Monthly, at The Old Red Lion in Islington. It's built to be a habit, not a one-off — exact dates confirmed here and by email.

items.question: What actually happens on the night?
items.answer: Two halves. The first hour is fast and topical — sketches, songs and stand-up responding to whatever's happened that week, hosted by a different guest star each month. The second half is a work-in-progress sharing from one member of the Here & Now ensemble.

items.question: Can I perform or pitch material?
items.answer: We'll open this up as the monthly run beds in — join the mailing list to hear when submissions open.

items.question: Is it suitable for everyone?
items.answer: It's a late-night scratch night aimed at adults — expect sharp humour and topical material. Age guidance will be confirmed nearer the first date.
